parts.text: Which prevention step best matches how this stomach infection spreads?

options.text: Boil or otherwise treat drinking water so pathogens are not swallowed.
Wear a mask near the neighbour so cough droplets are blocked, even though this infection spreads by water.
Drink the water if it looks clear, because clear water cannot carry pathogens.
Avoid touching the neighbour's arm only; sharing untreated drinking water stays safe.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Navya learns that a neighbour's stomach infection spreads when pathogens in untreated drinking water are swallowed. The neighbour also keeps a used handkerchief that others might borrow.

part_answers.answer: The pathogens spread when untreated water is swallowed, so treating drinking water matches that route.

teacher.key_rationale: Prevention must match the spread route: water-borne pathogens call for treating drinking water. Masks, clear looks, or avoiding touch alone do not block swallowing contaminated water.
